name: My Mind
tagline: A map of ideas. Tab adds a child, Enter a sibling. The map is the save.
description:
Click a bubble and type. Tab inserts a child, Enter a sibling, arrows walk the map, Delete removes a node. Drag to pan, wheel to zoom. Colours, layouts (map, graph, tree), shapes, and a yes/no status live on each item.

The last map comes back the next time you open the app, still only on this device. New starts a blank map. There is no account, and nothing is sent anywhere — their Drive, Firebase, and WebDAV doors are not in this app.

An unofficial port of My Mind by Ondřej Žára. Same map, same keys.
